verdict.rationale: Qodo is a SaaS code-review platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API reference, no API explorer and no runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The MCP server, CLI and llms.txt are adjacent agent-integration features, not an interactive API reference, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
